content: German/EU compliance for a purely private, non-commercial, no-data site: GDPR Art. 8 - Germany consent age 16 for information-society services; if NO personal data is collected/processed, GDPR processing rules largely don't trigger - but a basic privacy notice (Art. 13) is still prudent and must be in clear child-understandable language if children targeted. Tracking (even 'light' analytics, third-party fonts/scripts that relay IPs) creates data-processing obligations and should be avoided entirely. Impressum: required for 'geschaeftsmassige' (commercial/ongoing revenue) services per §5 DDG (replaced §5 TMG May 2024); purely private personal/family sites are exempt but the line is fuzzy - adding one is cheap insurance, reachable in max 2 clicks. Hosting: US hosts (GitHub Pages/Netlify) transit IPs on their CDN - legally fine for no-analytics static sites but worth documenting; Netlify/Cloudflare Pages free tiers collect request IPs.
